visualCharacteristics.purpose: text beside media (image, several images, linked image or click-to-play video), one row per pair
traits: two columns at desktop, equal widths by default
authored cell order sets the media side
several images in one cell sit side by side (photo + QR code)
poster image with a play button bottom-left that starts an inline video
option sidebar: first cell 75%, second 25% (Lufthansa .airem-sidebar), 40px above / 46px below
option slider: several images in a media cell become slides with dots below 1025px
option stacked: several images in a media cell one under the other, each with its {caption} paragraph
option padded: 32px above the first row and 32px to the next component (Lufthansa column view)
option nested-N: an image opening a text cell is one column of an N-column view nested in the cell (icons), empty cells keep their column

contentPattern.structure: 2 columns, one or more rows (one row per text/media pair). Each cell is either media or text: a cell holding only pictures and links is media, any other cell is text, so text | text and image | image are also valid. Cell order sets the media side. Media cell: one image; or several images (shown side by side, e.g. photo + QR code); or a linked image (an image wrapped in a link, or an image with a bare link (link text = URL) in the same paragraph, which then wraps the image; a link with real link text stays a visible link); or a video: poster image plus a link to an .mp4 file, rendered as the poster with a play button (bottom left) that replaces it with an inline video with controls (looping). The play button's accessible name is the .mp4 link text when it is not a URL, otherwise the locale default 'Play video' (EN) / 'Video abspielen' (DE). Text cell: headings, paragraphs, lists, links (bold link = primary button, italic = secondary). Option wide-media: media column 75%, text 25% from 768px, media shown first on mobile. Option sidebar: the first cell 75%, the second 25% from 768px whatever they hold; links to #anchors alone in a paragraph show a down arrow. Option slider (Lufthansa column view with carousel behaviour): below 1025px several images in one media cell are slides, one image at a time, with dots under it (68px below the image) that show the other images; from 1025px they stay side by side (/de/en/online-check-in app teaser: photo, QR code on the second slide). Without an option the columns are equal and mobile keeps the authored order. Rows or cells left empty are dropped; a row with a single cell spans the full width; rows with more than two cells get equal columns. External links open in a new tab. Section style 'grey' (Section Metadata) gives the grey band.

options.label: Slider (images as slides with dots below 1025px)
Stacked (several images in a media cell one under the other, with captions)
Padded (column-view spacing: 32px above, 32px to the next component)
Nested icons (an image opening a text cell a quarter of the cell wide from 1025px; also nested-2, nested-3)

usage: Text beside media on app-entry (/de/en/online-check-in), campaign (/de/en/100-years, with video and wide-media), flight-status (/de/en/timetable-and-flight-status), hub (/de/en/baggage), insights (article closing teaser with linked image) and legal (/de/en/imprint, text | text) pages.
reuseGuidance: Use for any side-by-side text and media row, including prose-only two-column text. For a heading plus logo strip per column use columns-logos; for card grids use the cards variants.
